StorySection.heading: The Beer for the moments you share.
StorySection.description: Everyone needs a crew. The people who make every moment richer, more real, and unforgettable. CREW Republic is the beer brewed for exactly that: good company, out there, together.

CrewmunitySection.heading: JOIN THE CREWMUNITY.
CrewmunitySection.description:
The CREW isn't just who you're with tonight. It's everyone sharing the same moments online.
Follow us, share your CREW moments, tag us, and become part of a crew that’s always around, wherever you are.
CrewmunitySection.imageAlt: Join the CREW Republic community online

TapSection.heading: TAP INTO THE CREW.
TapSection.description: Want your bar to become a CREW Hopspot? Bring CREW Republic to your taps and give your guests a beer worth sharing. And if you’d love to enjoy CREW at your favourite spot, ask your local bar to tap into the CREW. Cheers to good company and better beer.
TapSection.imageAlt: Tap into the CREW - fresh craft beer on tap

hero.imageAlt: CREW Republic Brand Story - Made for great moments

block1.heading: Everyone needs a CREW.
block1.description: We're social beings, so we seek out people who keep us grounded, lift us up, and make us feel like we belong. They like us just as we are. No explanations needed.
block1.imageAlt: Everyone needs a CREW - CREW Republic lifestyle

block2.heading: Community turns life into an experience.
block2.description: Our best memories are made together. Sharing them makes everything richer, more real, more meaningful. The people around us act like amplifiers, turning life up, and giving us the best snapshots in the photo album of our lives.
block2.imageAlt: Community turns life into an experience

block3.heading: CREW REPUBLIC IS THE BEER FOR MOMENTS THAT MATTER.
block3.description: When the hop flavor hits, you just know: this is a truly unique beer experience. If you love that feeling, you're already part of the CREW – a community with a shared passion for unforgettable moments with the people who matter.
block3.imageAlt: CREW Republic craft beer moments that matter
